faq.question: Q1. What is Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a process by Hartron (Haryana State Electronics Development Corporation Ltd.) to update its panel of Junior Programmers, engaged on job work basis across all districts of Haryana, as per Notification No. Hartron/ICTET/2026-27/03.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official district-wise roster lists 530 total positions across 23 districts of Haryana (computed by summing the Grand Total column of the roster). Hartron can increase or decrease this number until the date of recommendation, based on actual requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 09.08.2026 (applications opened on 30.07.2026).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A graduate degree (55% marks) with PGDCA/PDCA/PGDIT/APGDCA, or a BCA/B.Sc.(Comp.Sc./IT)/MCA/M.Sc.(Comp.Sc./IT)/B.Tech/M.Tech with 55% marks, or a three-year diploma in Computer Application/IT from SBTE/University or an 'A'/'B'/'C' level course from DOE/NIELIT with 55% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹300 + GST for General category male candidates of Haryana and male candidates of other states (including reserved categories); ₹150 + GST for female candidates; ₹75 + GST for Haryana SC/BC/EWS/ESM male and female candidates; and NIL for PWD candidates of Haryana.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through Hartron's official website, hartron.org.in, selecting only one district, between 30.07.2026 and 09.08.2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Domain Knowledge Test (1st test), training for those who qualify, and a Practical/Project Test (2nd test), with merit prepared using equal weightage to both tests, followed by panel formation as per the reservation roster.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Hartron Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The remuneration for Junior Programmer is ₹24,100/- per month, engaged on job work basis.

faq.question: Q9. Does clearing the test guarantee a job placement?
faq.answer: No. Merely clearing the test and making it to the panel does not guarantee placement - candidates are recommended only on receipt of confirmed requirement from the indenting organization.
